name: @standardicon/mcp

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Find icons by meaning, name, or what they look like. Returns names with a description of each drawing and when to use it.

query.description: What the icon is for, or what it looks like. For example "delete", "upload file", or "bell with a plus".

category.description: Only search one category. list_categories gives the names.

tools.name: get_icon
tools.description: Get one icon as SVG markup, at a size and weight. The SVG draws in currentColor. Sizes: 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 28, 32, 40, 48. Weights: regular, medium, semibold, bold, black; Semibold comes in 18 and up, bold in 32 and up, and black in 40 and up.

name.description: The icon name, or one of its aliases, as returned by search_icons.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the icon categories and how many icons each has.

tools.name: list_icons
tools.description: List every icon in one category, with a description of each drawing.

instructions:
The Standard Icon Set: 1227 SVG icons with a 1px line, drawn for every size from 16 to 48. Use these tools whenever a design or UI needs an icon.

1. Find icons with search_icons. Search by meaning ("delete", "settings") or by what it looks like ("bell with a plus").
2. Get the SVG with get_icon, at the size it will show. Paste the SVG inline; it draws in currentColor, so it takes the text color around it.
3. If nothing fits, say the set doesn't have that icon. Don't draw a substitute or borrow one from another set, so the design stays consistent.

Sizes: 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 28, 32, 40, 48. Weights: regular, medium, semibold, bold, black. Semibold comes in 18 and up, bold in 32 and up, and black in 40 and up.
